item.title: Denzel Curry, Galantis, Peking Duk and More Perform at BASSINTHEGRASS 2026 in Darwin
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and events. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the BASSINTHEGRASS 2026 music festival in Darwin, Australia. Let's get started!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "On Saturday, May 16th, the Mindil Beach in Darwin came alive with over 12,000 attendees at the BASSINTHEGRASS 2026 festival. The event featured more than 20 international and Australian artists, including Denzel Curry, Galantis, and Peking Duk. One in five attendees were visitors to the Territory, making it a huge success for tourism."
[Short clip of Denzel Curry's music plays]
Host: "The festival's unique atmosphere and setting didn't go unnoticed. Galantis DJ Christian Karlsson said it was 'an absolutely mind-blowing experience' and encouraged everyone to come to Darwin. Even Playlunch lead singer Liam Bell raved about the festival, saying the people, vibes, and food were amazing."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But it's not just the music that makes BASSINTHEGRASS special. According to Tourism and Events NT CEO Suzana Bishop, it's the combination of world-class live music, Darwin's natural beauty, and incredible food that makes it unlike any other festival. And the numbers back it up - Darwin hotel occupancy reached 70% over the event weekend, a 10-point increase from last year."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you at the next music festival. Don't forget to subscribe to our podcast for more music news and updates."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
